author: claude-opus-5-5
visual_review: Two palmate leaves on stems (large upper right, small lower left), leaflets fanned upward from each base, longest in the middle; reads as two cannabis leaves at 48.
omissions: Leaflets are single strokes, not serrated outlines: two outlined palmate leaves need about 32 units of width each at 8-unit spacing (tested: outlined 5-lobe passes only at 0.9 scale, 3-lobe reads as a lotus).
